source.author: OpenKal contributors
source.origin: Project-defined cosmetic definitions from local filename and visual observations, with public equipment-grade labels.
source.scope: Project-authored generic English appearance labels and class/slot/model coordinates only. No external art, item tables, combat stats or reference item IDs are redistributed. Grade labels describe appearances; actual item level requirements remain 1.

g56_extension.review: These sixteen appearances were initially mislabeled G59. Direct comparison with the official G56 images confirmed the correction. Existing IDs and models remain unchanged.

g59_extension.review: Direct comparison with official G59 equipment images establishes the appearance families. The three existing Thief appearances were already correct; eighteen missing appearances are added. All models and textures loaded and isolated front/back previews were inspected. Runtime gameplay and complete animation verification remain pending.

equipment_expansion.review: Matching armor sets and isolated weapon/shield front/back previews were reviewed. Gameplay and complete animation review remain pending.

deferred: No matching Darkness armor was identified for Thief; its group 9 appearance is golden.
No Magician group 20 weapon model was present in the inspected local inventory. Other unclassified staff models are not substituted.
Alternate Knight group 9 upper/head variants show missing coverage or unrelated head geometry; only the complete 09-01 set is offered.
darkness.grade_label: Darkness grades differ across legacy references; use the appearance family name without asserting a numeric grade.
